title: Send a long video or thread to your bot with one reply
summary: See a long video or X thread you don't have time for? Reply to it by tagging your bot, and a short summary waits for you in your bot's app later.
what_the_bot_does: Watches for posts where you tag it with a request like "summarize this and send it to my bot".
Reads the thread or video you replied to.
Writes a short summary in plain words.
Drops the summary into your bot's chat so you can read it when you have a minute.
what_you_end_up_with: A read-later pile of short summaries, saved without copying links or leaving the app you were scrolling.

tools.note: The source post uses the @bot tag on X

prompt: When I send you a video or thread to save, write me a summary with: one sentence on what it is, the 3 to 5 main points, anything I should act on, and the link. Keep it under 150 words. Put new summaries in one running list, newest first, and once a day tell me how many are waiting. Don't reply to or post anything on X for me.
setup: Connect your bot to your X account first, so it knows which tags come from you.
Try it on one short post before trusting it with long videos.
watch_out: Your reply that tags the bot is public, so anyone can see what you saved.
Summaries can miss nuance. Open the original before you quote it or act on it.

sources.label: X post by @Texas_Twins_Dad (2026-10-20): replies "@bot summarize this and send it to my bot" under long videos and threads; the summary waits in the Grok Bot app
